## Executive Summary

Boomi Tech Solutions is a premier technology services company delivering enterprise-grade solutions in AI development, cloud infrastructure, SAAS platforms, and digital transformation. With 18+ years of combined expertise and 500+ successful projects, we help businesses modernize their technology stack and accelerate growth.

**Q: How quickly can you start a project?**

**Q: Do you work with startups or only enterprises?**
A: We work with both! From early-stage startups needing MVP development to Fortune 500 companies requiring enterprise solutions.

**Q: What is your typical project timeline?**
A: Timelines vary by project scope. MVPs can be delivered in 8-12 weeks, while enterprise solutions may take 6-12 months. We provide detailed timelines during discovery.
